items.title: Runbook: Refunding a duplicate charge
items.body:
INTERNAL. Refunding a duplicate charge: use this when a ticket or alert points to this problem.

## Triage checklist

- Confirm the account ID and the affected invoices or users.
- Check status.acmecloud.example and the on-call channel for a known incident.
- Note the time the problem started.

## Steps

1. Verify both charges in the gateway.
2. Refund the later one.
3. Credit note.
4. Customer reply.
5. Audit note.

## Customer communication

Acknowledge the problem, say what we are doing and when the customer will hear from us next. Never promise a refund or account change before it is approved.

## Safety rule

Refunds and account changes need a second person's approval, recorded in the admin console.

## Escalation

Escalate to the on-call engineer if more than one customer is affected or the problem lasts longer than 30 minutes.
